text.p: Oil product inventories held in independent tankage in the Amsterdam-Rotterdam-Antwerp area were estimated to be at the following levels currently, a week ago and a year ago, industry sources said.
All figures in thousands of tonnes:
Gas oil stocks were balanced as some product arrived from the former Soviet Union and some left for Germany, but ice hampered large-scale barge movements.
Gasoline inventories rose slightly as arriving cargoes outweighed departing barge traffic to Germany.
Naphtha stocks dipped as the German chemical sector took material, but few cargoes arrived.
Fuel oil was balanced as bunker demand was sufficient to absorb incoming barges and coasters.
Jet fuel was also steady, as material arrived, but also left for the gas oil pool. -- Amsterdam Newsroom +31 20 504 5004
